notes.title: About an upcoming update
notes.notes:
I have been working on a 5-year anniversary update for Dr. Atominus. It's coming a bit late, but here is a sneak peak to the update and also some other important info.


A lot of polishing and quality of life updates
The update will include many small improvements to the game, like improved knockback, hard difficulty and remastered sound. There are also performance improvements and bug fixes.

Along with the update, native Linux support will be coming to Steam. It already works well with proton, but native support has some advantages, like faster startup and easier to navigate game files.


Saving system change and backwards compatibility
Recently Dr. Atominus became available for Playstation 4. A new efficient save system was added for this and it will be on the PC version too. Because of this, old save files will not be compatible with the updated game. That is why I'm telling about the update in advance, so in case you are just playing through the game, you might want to disable updates temporarily. The update will probably be coming either next week or the week after that.



I will tell more details about the update when it comes.



Edit: The update will be coming August 11.

notes.title: Update Version 2.3.0
notes.notes:
Dr. Atominus Version 2.3.0

Dr. Atominus was just updated! In this update, some graphics were improved and there were also some other small improvements.


Improved some graphics

The sprites / images of 2 bosses have been improved a little. First, the infamously ugly spider.

Before:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/d56ce57befafa3302086a3f1cf2bcf32add17ad7.png

After:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/d6034f511eb1210ecce02eab0ceeb62575b7b6fe.png

Also, the true last boss. But I’m not putting the image here because of spoilers.


Other improvements
 In the settings, when changing the language, it will now always show the word "language" in English too, so the option is easier to find when accidentally changing the language
 The game engine and other software was updated. Thanks to that, the download size of the game is a little smaller. The file size never was large, but even a little helps people with not much free space.



That’s all. I hope this update will improve the overall quality of the game. :)

Here is a little update for Dr. Atominus.

Version 2.2.1!

notes.title: Partial controller support and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Dr. Atominus has been updated to version 1.0.1. Here are the changes:

Features
- Added partial controller support. It works with at least playstation 4 controller. Other controllers haven't been tested. You might need to adjust controller settings -> Go to Steam>Settings>Controller>General Controller Settings and uncheck all the boxes.
- Added a main menu
- Credits now redirect to the main menu
- Confirmation dialog color changed

Bug fixes
- Fixed a bug where an ability didn't get saved
- Big door displays tip to press Z
- Atom was accidentally behind some things and in front of some things, now it's in the correct position
